These pathways highlight a potential indirect relationship between lovastatin and Riboflavin synthase, mediated through different targets. The scores from the two paths suggest some level of confidence in this relationship, though the strength is lower in the second path. The evidence supports a plausible but indirect connection between lovastatin and Riboflavin synthase, emphasizing the role of secondary targets in the overall pharmacological effect.
